helpCenter.subtitle: Quick answers to common questions.
helpCenter.stillNeedHelpText: Our support team is ready to assist you with any technology product or order questions.

q1.question: How do I track my SHOPCART order?
q1.answer: Once your order ships, you will receive an email with a tracking link. You can also sign in to your account and visit the Orders section to see live tracking updates.

q2.question: What is the return policy for technology products?
q2.answer: Most technology items can be returned within 30 days of delivery if they are unopened and in original condition. Some products, such as software and consumables, may not be eligible for return once opened.

q3.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
q3.answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and bank transfer for eligible orders.

q4.question: How long does delivery take?
q4.answer: Standard delivery takes 3-5 business days. Express delivery is available in 1-2 business days for most metropolitan areas. Remote locations may take an extra 1-2 days.

q5.question: Do your products come with a warranty?
q5.answer: Yes. All electronics sold on SHOPCART include the manufacturer warranty. Many items also qualify for our extended protection plans at checkout.

q6.question: How can I change or cancel my order?
q6.answer: Orders can be modified or canceled within 30 minutes of placement. After that, the order may already be processed for shipping. Contact support as soon as possible for assistance.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lastUpdated: Last updated: September 2026. Learn how we handle your personal data and tech order details.
privacy.overviewText: Your privacy is crucial to us. As an e-commerce platform for tech hardware and digital tools, we only collect and process the data necessary to fulfill your orders and support your tech products.
privacy.needHelp: Need help? Reach out at privacy@yourtechstore.com

s1.title: 1. Information We Collect
s1.content: We collect customer details to process tech hardware orders, manage device warranties, and deliver software licenses. This includes your name, shipping address, billing info, email, and contact number.

s2.title: 2. Technical & Device Telemetry
s2.content: For smart tech products, firmware downloads, and peripherals, we may collect technical hardware IDs, OS versions, and diagnostic logs to verify compatibility and support device updates.

s3.title: 3. Cookies & Local Storage
s3.content: We use cookies and browser storage to keep track of your active shopping cart, remember user preferences, and monitor product loading performance across devices.

s4.title: 4. Security & Encryption
s4.content: All store checkout actions are encrypted with TLS 1.3 standards. Payment details are handled directly by PCI-DSS compliant payment gateways, and we never store raw credit card numbers.

s5.title: 5. Contact & Privacy Requests
s5.content: You can request access, modifications, or permanent deletion of your profile data and past order records by emailing support@yourtechstore.com.
